title: Launch Out into the Deep
book: The New Testament, January 2027 (Come and See!)
p1: A big crowd pressed close to Jesus by the lake. Nearby, fishermen were washing their nets.
Jesus sat in Simon Peter’s boat and taught the people from the water. Then He said, “Go out to the deep water. Let down your nets.”
Peter said, “Master, we fished all night and caught nothing. But because You say so, I will.”
p2: The net filled with so many fish that it began to break! Friends came to help, and both boats began to sink. Peter fell at Jesus’s knees, amazed. Jesus said, “Do not be afraid. From now on you will catch people.” They left everything and followed Him.
When something feels hard, try again like Peter. Tonight, say his words: “Because You say so, I will.”
note: Rewritten the picture-book way and rated 9-10 by a reviewer that did not write it (29 Oct 2026).
